Real Oviedo is a Spanish professional football club based in Oviedo, Asturias. Founded on 26 March 1926, the club plays in the Segunda División, the second level of the Spanish football league system. The club plays at the Estadio Carlos Tartiere, opened on 30 September 2000, and is the largest sports stadium in Asturias. In the La Liga all-time league table, Real Oviedo ranks 19th, having played 39 seasons in the top flight.
